name: Alexandria Castle
description: A grand white stone castle with towering spires, surrounded by a bustling medieval city. Colorful banners flutter in the wind. A theater stage is set up in the courtyard.

props.label:
Alexandria Castle
Jewel of the Mist Continent

dialogues_by_quest.kidnap_princess:0: I can't stay here any longer. My mother... she's changed.
dialogues_by_quest.kidnap_princess:1: Please, you must help me escape! Take me away from here.
dialogues_by_quest.kidnap_princess:2: Thank you... let's hurry to the forest before the guards notice.
dialogues_by_quest.after:kidnap_princess: I'll never forget what you did for me, Zidane.

dialogues_by_quest.kidnap_princess:0: You there! Ruffian! Stay away from the princess!
dialogues_by_quest.kidnap_princess:1: Princess! I cannot allow this! These are common thieves!
dialogues_by_quest.after:kidnap_princess: Hmph. I suppose even a thief can have noble intentions.

dialogues_by_quest.default: The eidolons will be mine... ALL of them!
dialogues_by_quest.after:kidnap_princess: You'll pay for taking my daughter!

ambient_npcs.name: Castle Guard
ambient_npcs.dialogue: Welcome to Alexandria Castle. The play begins at sunset.

ambient_npcs.name: Noble Lady
ambient_npcs.dialogue: Have you heard? The Tantalus theater troupe is performing tonight!

ambient_npcs.name: Excited Child
ambient_npcs.dialogue: I wanna see the play! I wanna see the play!

ambient_npcs.name: Merchant
ambient_npcs.dialogue: Finest potions in all of Alexandria! ...Well, the only potions, really.

ambient_npcs.name: Old Scholar
ambient_npcs.dialogue: The Iifa Tree to the south... they say it's the source of the Mist that blankets our land.

on_enter_events.text: The grand castle of Alexandria rises before you. Colorful banners flutter in the warm evening breeze as crowds gather for tonight's theater performance.
